page.overview:
Who is Stanton Family?

Stanton's Family in Fazbear Frights comprises the relatives of Robert Stanton from The Cliffs, the first story of Fazbear Frights 7: The Cliffs.

Robert Stanton is the main protagonist of the seventh Fazbear Frights book's first story.

After losing Tyler, Robert considers suicide because he has lost everyone who mattered to him. As he is contemplating his decision, he realizes that Anna would have wanted him to live for as long as possible, even without her. He angrily chucks Tag-Along Freddy off the Cliffs to look for Tyler. When he finds him, he begins to tell him stories about Anna.
